content: Implement route handler for DELETE /api/users/:id with complete middleware chain and E2E tests
activeForm: Implementing route handler for DELETE /api/users/:id with complete middleware chain and E2E tests
description: Implement user.routes.ts with DELETE /api/users/:id endpoint. Integrates authentication middleware (JWT validation), parameter validation middleware (id validation), and controller from T3.4. Write 4 MVP-tier tests (integration tests for middleware chain, E2E tests for complete deletion flow). This subtask completes the full DELETE /api/users/:id feature.

checkpoints.name: Route Registration Complete
checkpoints.requirement: DELETE /api/users/:id route registered with middleware chain (auth → validation → controller)

checkpoints.name: Middleware Chain and E2E Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: Route implementation complete with all 4 tests passing (middleware execution and E2E flow verified)

phases.name: Route Registration
actions: Update: src/services/user-service/routes/user.routes.ts
Register: router.delete('/:id', ...middleware, deleteUserProfile)
Add: authenticate middleware (JWT validation, populate req.user)
Add: validateRequest(getUserParamsSchema) for :id parameter (INTEGER validation)
Wire: controller.deleteUserProfile from T3.4
Order: authenticate → validateParams → controller
phases.gate: Middleware chain must execute in correct order before proceeding

phases.name: Error Handling and Response Formatting
actions: Implement: 401 response for missing/invalid JWT
Implement: 400 response for invalid :id parameter (not INTEGER)
Implement: 403 response for unauthorized deletion (other user)
Implement: 404 response for non-existent user
Implement: 204 No Content response for successful deletion
Format: Consistent error response structure
Handle: CORS preflight for DELETE requests

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (4 tests)
actions: Write: Test 1 - Successful deletion returns 204 No Content
Write: Test 2 - Missing JWT returns 401
Write: Test 3 - User cannot delete other user (403)
Write: Test 4 - E2E flow (login → delete own account → verify soft delete)
Verify: All 4 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of route layer
Verify: Middleware executes in correct order
Verify: Complete deletion flow works end-to-end
